race.description: Coastal Commercial Lining Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: CANAL (2) returns a gelding and makes his stable debut for the Snowden camp. Appears to have come on terrifically from the ultimate gear change and gets a key booking in Looker. Will take plenty of beating fresh. PARKER'S PARADISE (10) improved sharply last time at Grafton when sent forward at a big price, only to be gunned down late. Fitter and gets in light with the claim. Will prove tougher to run down this time. JWALA (8) is a Hellbent mare on debut for the Howlett team. Heywood's booking is a good push, so is one to keep safe. BOBBY (1) has mixed his form but gave a bold sight at Gosford last time. Fitter and can give cheek again.
